description:
A phone's diff file picker follows the ranked order. The conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} works in a git repo whose top commit, "Highlighted commit", changes src/zeta.ts (line 160 becomes "const critical = true;"), README.md and src/alpha.ts, and carries commit highlights that rank the files zeta.ts, README.md, alpha.ts and comment on src/zeta.ts line 160 ("The one line that matters.") and README.md line 3 ("Docs follow the code."). "The overlay" is the ".diff-viewer-overlay" element; "the files" are the overlay's ".diff-tree-row[aria-selected]" elements, in document order; "the second file" is the one at index 1 (pick it with "nth": 1, scoped with "within" the overlay). Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait for the message input ([data-testid="message-input"]) to be visible (allow 30s).
2. Open the Diffs workspace tool: wait for the ".header" element to be visible, then click the button with accessible name exactly "Diffs" inside ".chat-workspace-actions" (when that toolbar is not shown, click the button named exactly "More options" and then the button whose name starts with "Diffs" in ".chat-overflow-popover"). The overlay becomes visible (allow 30s).
3. "The picker" is the VISIBLE select element matching ".diff-viewer-file-selector-wrapper select" in the overlay; "the options" are its option elements. There are exactly 5 options: a placeholder, the commit message, then the ranked files.
4. In one eval with expect "true" testing each option's raw textContent: the third option matches / src\/zeta\.ts .*★1$/, the fourth matches / README\.md .*★1$/ and the fifth matches / src\/alpha\.ts /.
5. The narrow diff is inline; the comment still shows under its line: select the option with value "src/zeta.ts" in the picker. "The callout" is the overlay's ".diff-highlight-callout-text": it has exactly the text "The one line that matters." and is in the viewport.
6. A tap on the callout's button opens the comment dialog, though Monaco claims touches inside the editor: tap (touch start, then touch end) the button with role "button" and name "Comment" inside the overlay's element with role "note". The ".diff-viewer-comment-dialog" text then contains "Add Comment (Line 160, new)".

steps.expression: (() => { const sel = [...document.querySelectorAll('.diff-viewer-overlay .diff-viewer-file-selector-wrapper select')].find(e => e.checkVisibility()); const opts = [...sel.options]; const t2 = opts[2].textContent; const t3 = opts[3].textContent; const t4 = opts[4].textContent; const r2 = / src\/zeta\.ts .*★1$/.test(t2); const r3 = / README\.md .*★1$/.test(t3); const r4 = / src\/alpha\.ts /.test(t4); return String(r2 && r3 && r4); })()
